name: PROWL WhatsApp Bot
description: PROWL is a powerful, customizable WhatsApp automation bot built for reliable deployment on Heroku and other Node.js platforms. It includes session-based authentication, group moderation, media tools, AI integrations, persistent settings, scheduled utilities, and a clean command system.

SESSION_ID.description: Required WhatsApp session ID. Use the PROWL format: PROWL:~ followed by your base64 session value.

BOT_NAME.description: Display name used in menus, connection notices, and bot replies. Defaults to PROWL.

BOT_PREFIX.description: Command prefix used by PROWL, such as . or !. Defaults to a period.

BOT_MODE.description: Initial operating mode. Supported values include public, private, group, solo, sudo, super, buttons, and channel.

BOT_TIMEZONE.description: Timezone used for menu clocks, schedules, and time-related commands, for example Africa/Nairobi or America/New_York.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner WhatsApp number in international format without a plus sign. Example: 254700000000.

DATABASE_URL.description: Optional PostgreSQL connection URL for cloud persistence. Leave blank to use the included SQLite storage.

MONGODB_URI.description: Optional MongoDB connection URL for persistent cloud storage. Leave blank unless MongoDB is configured.

APIX_API_KEY.description: Optional APIX key for supported AI and media commands.

PTERODACTYL_URL.description: Optional Pterodactyl panel URL used by panel-management commands.

PTERODACTYL_KEY.description: Optional Pterodactyl Application API key. Only configure this when panel-management commands are required.

PAYSTACK_KEY.description: Optional Paystack secret key for payment-related commands. Do not commit or share this value.
